main_block: Superset 1: complete all sets before moving on
Exercise A: [IMF-149 | Lat Pulldown, Wide Grip] 4 sets of 10 reps, controlled pull down and slow return
Exercise B: [IMF-223 | Cable Pushdown, Rope] 4 sets of 12 reps, full extension at the bottom with a brief squeeze
Rest: 45 to 60 seconds after completing both exercises, then repeat
Superset 2: complete all sets before moving on
Exercise A: [IMF-157 | Seated Cable Row, Close Grip] 4 sets of 10 reps, drive the elbows back and hold briefly at the end
Exercise B: [IMF-226 | Overhead Cable Extension, Rope] 4 sets of 12 reps, keep the upper arms still and extend fully
Rest: 45 to 60 seconds after completing both exercises, then repeat
Superset 3: complete all sets before moving on
Exercise A: [IMF-160 | Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row] 3 sets of 12 reps, squeeze the shoulder blades together at the top
Exercise B: [IMF-026 | Pallof Press] 3 sets of 12 reps each side, press out slowly and resist any rotation
Rest: 45 to 60 seconds after completing both exercises, then repeat
Superset 4: complete all sets before moving on
Exercise A: [IMF-153 | Straight-Arm Pulldown] 3 sets of 15 reps, keep a slight bend in the elbows throughout
Exercise B: [IMF-028 | Plank, Forearms] 3 sets of 30 seconds, breathe steadily and keep the hips level
Rest: 45 to 60 seconds after completing both exercises, then repeat
